verdict.rationale: LobeHub runs real, browsable registries: a Skills marketplace with about 334k SKILL.md bundles (docs-14) and an MCP server directory with over 100k ranked servers (docs-12). It documents a one-command install, `npx -y @lobehub/market-cli skills install … --agent cursor` (docs-40), and the desktop app can install and run MCP connectors (docs-5). missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the install works, documentation of an in-app one-click install flow into LobeChat itself (the sample command targets an external agent).
